callees.name: _fm_agent_config_path
callees.pre_condition: project_root is a Path identifying an existing directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a Path: the value of the FM_AGENT_CONFIG environment variable when set, otherwise <project_root>/fm-agent.toml.

callees.name: detect_opencode_config_path
callees.post_condition: Returns a Path to the OpenCode configuration file: the value of the OPENCODE_CONFIG environment variable when set; otherwise, opencode.jsonc when it exists in the platform-specific OpenCode configuration directory, or opencode.json otherwise.
